source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: In the Satavahana period 'Amatya' means?
x: Amatya means minister. The four amatyas advising the king were Vishwasamatya, Rajamatya, Maha Amatya (finance) and Maha Talavara (army commander).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: Which of the following tells about local self-government during the Chola period?
x: The Uttaramerur inscription of Parantaka Chola-I gives details of local self-government during the Chola period.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: Who among the following carried out a naval invasion of Southeast Asia?
x: Rajendra-I invaded Indonesia and defeated Sangrama Vijayottungavarman, earning the title 'Kadaramkonda'. He also conquered southern Sri Lanka.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: With whom did the Rashtrakutas fight to capture Kanauj?
o: The Pratiharas, kings of the Pala dynasty
x: After Harsha there was a tripartite struggle for Kanauj between the Pratiharas, the Palas of Bengal and the Rashtrakutas of the Deccan.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: Who among the following kings of Vijayanagara reconciled the conflict between Jains and Vaishnavas?
x: In 1368 Bukkaraya-I resolved the dispute in which Vaishnavites were harassing the Jains of Srirangam. His titles included Vaidika Marga Pravartaka.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: Main cause of conflict between Bahmani and Vijayanagara kings?
o: The kings of Vijayanagara did not pay the tax the Bahmanis
x: The triangular area between the Krishna and Tungabhadra (Raichur Doab) led to many wars between Vijayanagara and the Bahmani Sultans. The conflict began in 1356 under Harihara-I.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: Which of the following does not belong to the subject of 'Amukthamalyada'?
o: Tells the story of Godadevi's marriage.
Political matters are known in it.
Revealed the Genealogy of Bukkaraya to Krishnadevaraya
x: Amuktamalyada (Vishnuchittiyamu) by Krishnadevaraya describes the marriage of Vishnuchitta's adopted daughter Godadevi with Sriranganatha. It is one of the Telugu Panchakavyas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: Who among the following shifted the capital of Bahmani from Gulbarga to Bidar?
x: Ahmad Shah Bahmani shifted the capital from Gulbarga to Bidar.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: Which of the following is not true about Gol Gumbaj?
o: It is the tomb of Muhammad Adil Shah
There is no mosque and no arches near the tomb
Its dome is one of the largest such
x: Gol Gumbaz at Bijapur, Karnataka is the mid-17th century tomb of Mohammad Adil Shah, the seventh Sultan. It is an important example of Adil Shahi architecture.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: The end of 'police action' in Hyderabad?
x: Hyderabad was incorporated into India on 17 September 1948 after Operation Polo.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: Which musical instrument gained prominence during the Vijayanagara Empire?
x: The Veena gained prominence during the Vijayanagara Empire. Sri Krishnadevaraya is said to have studied veena with a scholar named Krishna.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: Initially who mentioned about Forts in Andhra?
x: Megasthenes in his Indika (4th century BC) wrote that the Andhras had 30 forts, one lakh infantry, 3,000 cavalry and 2,000 elephants. He was the first foreigner to mention Andhra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: At Amaravati, Jaggaiyapet and Nagarjuna hills stupas and viharas are built on whose remains?
x: Dhatugarbha stupas were built over the bodily remains of the Buddha. Paribhojaka stupas held articles used by Buddhist teachers.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p27
s: Who was the founder of Tuluva dynasty?
x: Veera Narasimharaya (1505-1509) was the founder of the Tuluva dynasty. Thimmaraju was its progenitor.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s:
Which of the following is incorrectly paired?
1. Deshabhakta - Konda Venkatappayya
2. Andhra Ratna - Duggirala Gopalakrishnaiah
3. Andhra Kesari - Tanguturi Prakasam
4. Desoddharaka - Bhogaraju Pattabhi Sitaramaiah
x: Option 4 is wrongly matched. The title Desoddharaka belonged to Kasinadhuni Nageswara Rao (also called Viswadatha).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s: Who was the first to accept the method of Subsidiary Alliance introduced by Lord Wellesley?
x: On 1 September 1798 Nizam Ali Khan (Asaf Jah-II) accepted Wellesley's Subsidiary Alliance. Hyderabad thus became the first princely state to become a British protectorate.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s: Who was Nizam's Supreme Commander during the Hyderabad police action?
x: The Nizam's Supreme Commander during the Hyderabad Police Action (13-17 September 1948) was L. Edrus.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s: In Andhra, who among the following started a monthly magazine 'Satihita Bodhini' in 1883?
x: Veeresalingam founded Vivekavardhini (1874), Hasyasanjeevani (1876), Satihitabodhini (1883) and Satyasamvardhini (1891).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s: Who was elected as Chief Minister in the populist government formed in Hyderabad state in 1952?
x: Burgula Ramakrishna Rao became Chief Minister of Hyderabad State in 1952.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s: Rajamahendri, i.e. present day Rajahmundry, was built under which dynasty?
x: After Vengi was destroyed in a war of succession, Eastern Chalukya Ammaraja-I built Rajamahendravaram on the Godavari after his title Rajamahendra. He shifted his capital there from Vengi.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s: Who among the following was awarded the title of 'Founder of Kakati Rajya'?
x: Recherla Rudra saved the Kakatiya kingdom while Ganapatideva was a captive of the Devagiri Yadavas. He earned the titles Kakatiya Rajyabhara Daureya and Kakatiya Rajya Samartha.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s: Which of the following is the city described in Vallabhamatya's "Kridabhiramam"?
x: Vinukonda Vallabhamatya's street drama Kridabhiramam, based on Ravipati Tripurantaka's Premabhiramam, describes social life in the city of Orugallu (Warangal). It mentions the sports and entertainments of the Kakatiya period.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s: Where the French established the first trade center in Andhra in 1669?
x: The first French settlement in Andhra was established at Machilipatnam in 1669 with the permission of Abdullah Qutb Shah.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s: Who was the founder of Asaf Jahi Dynasty in Deccan?
x: The founder of the Asaf Jahi dynasty was Nizam-ul-Mulk.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s: Which of the following organizations published the first Telugu magazine 'Satyadootha'?
x: The first Telugu magazine, the monthly Satyaduta, was started in 1835 from Madras by the Christian Association of Bellary for propagating Christianity.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s: All inscriptions of Satavahanas?
o: Both in Prakrit language and Brahmi script
Both in Sanskrit language and Prakrit script
Both in Brahmi language and Devanagari script.
Both in Brahmi language and Prakrit script.
x: The administrative and royal language of the Satavahanas was Prakrit. All their inscriptions are in Prakrit language and Brahmi script.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s: What were the gold coins called during the Kakatiya period?
x: Kakatiya gold coins were called Mada and Nishka; the largest gold coin was the Gadyana. The Ruka was a silver coin, ten Rukas making one Mada.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p28
s: "Kavi sarvabhouma" Srinatha graced whose court?
x: Srinatha was the education officer (Vidyadhikari) in the court of Pedakomati Vemareddy.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p29
s:
Which of the following is the wrong stated pair?
1. Pingali Surana - Kala Purnodayam
2. Tenali Ramakrishna - Panduranga Mahatmyam
3. Ramaraja Bhushana - Prabhavati Pradyumnam
4. Madayagari Mallana - Rajasekhara Charithra
x: Prabhavati Pradyumnam was written by Pingali Suranna, whose other works are Kala Purnodayam and Raghava Pandaviyam. Ramaraja Bhushana wrote Vasucharitra and Narasabhupaliyam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p29
s: Who was the leader of the Wahabi movement, an anti-British movement by Andhra Muslims in the 19th century?
x: In 1839 Mubariz-ud-Daula (Nasir-ud-Daula's brother) led the Wahabi movement in Hyderabad. The movement, begun by Syed Ahmad of Bareilly for social reform, later became anti-British.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p29
s: Which of the following is the only temple in Andhra Pradesh with two flagpoles?
x: The Sri Kurmanatha temple at Srikurmam near Srikakulam, where Vishnu is worshipped as Kurma, has two flagpoles. The deity also faces west.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p29
s: Which of the following ancient texts does not mention Telugu people?
x: The book's explanation notes that the Andhras are first mentioned as a race in the Aitareya Brahmana, as the cursed sons of Vishwamitra who went south.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p35
s: Kandukuri Veeresalingam's "Rajasekhara Charita" is said to be based on which English book?
x: Oliver Goldsmith's Vicar of Wakefield is the basis for Kandukuri Veeresalingam's Rajasekhara Charitra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p35
s: Who is the famous Telugu poet who graced the court of Pedakomati Vemareddy?
x: According to the Phirangipuram inscription, Srinatha worked as education officer in the court of Pedakomati Vemareddy.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p35
s: Who were the kings who had the title of 'Mahamandaleswara'?
x: The Kakatiyas held the titles Andhra Deshadhiswara and Mahamandaleswara.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p35
s: Who was the Satavahana emperor who made the Amaravati Stupa wide and stone fence around the Mahachaitya?
x: Acharya Nagarjuna built a stone rampart for the Dhanyakataka Mahastupa during the time of Yagnashri Satakarni.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p35
s: Who was the Commander-in-Chief of the Nizam of Hyderabad State when the police action took place?
x: L. Edrus (Andrews) was the Nizam's Commander-in-Chief during the police action.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p35
s: Which was the first Telugu magazine published by Bellary Christian Society?
x: Satyaduta was published by the Bellary Christian Society for Christian propagation.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p2) p35
s: Who recently translated the "Dasarathi Shatakam" into English?
x: Dasarathi Shatakam was translated into English by Dr. Bhanumati Ramakrishna.
